mechanism_narrative: A further decline in WORKPLACES mobility over the next month will reduce commuting-linked discretionary spending and pull RETAIL_REC lower relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES remains below its current four-week mean throughout that window.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT keeps falling, more trips are substituted away from downtown shopping and RETAIL_REC drops within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below its current four-week mean while RESIDENTIAL rises above 8 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after TRANSIT weakens further and RESIDENTIAL stays above 8 points.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in GROCERY_PHARM after a mobility shock indicates broad easing of movement constraints, and that easing spills into higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 1 point week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days after a two-week increase in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility stays deeply negative, leisure demand remains concentrated outdoors and retail destinations lose incidental foot traffic, keeping RETAIL_REC below its prior four-week average over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -35 for at least two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while PARKS stays below -35 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to soften and TRANSIT also weakens, the combined reduction in daytime city-center flows will depress RETAIL_REC after about one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days despite simultaneous declines in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A continued rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility signals more time spent near home, which shifts spending to neighborhood essentials and lowers RETAIL_REC with a four-week lag.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stops declining and turns up, access to shopping districts improves and RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses from below -10 to above -10 week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after TRANSIT crosses above -10.

mechanism_narrative: In holiday-heavy periods, a simultaneous improvement in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM reflects broader outing intensity, and that broader activity lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves by at least 5 points while GROCERY_PHARM stays at or above 9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days when PARKS improves by at least 5 points and GROCERY_PHARM remains at or above 9.
